None of the SEC‑football‑champion schools that had at least one championship during 2000‑2020 meet all of the requested criteria:

| Georgia | Multiple | 26 Rhodes Scholars | **No** Marshall Scholars reported for 2020 or 2021 |
| Auburn | Multiple | 4 Rhodes Scholars | **No** Marshall Scholars reported for 2020 or 2021 |

- The SEC‑championship list (2000‑2020) is found on the SEC‑sports official page [1].
- The Rhodes Scholar counts for each institution come from the Rhodes Trust PDF [2].
- The Marshall Scholarship site provides no evidence that any of the five schools produced a Marshall Scholar in either 2020 or 2021; the 2020‑class announcement lists only Washington State, Rutgers, and SUNY Stony Brook as first‑time recipients [3], and the 2021 announcement likewise lists no SEC school [4].

Since every qualifying SEC school fails to satisfy the combined requirement of ≥10 Rhodes Scholars and at least one Marshall Scholar in 2020 or 2021, **no schools meet all criteria**.
